response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack and DLang developer but lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of hands-on C++ experience on the Windows platform. Furthermore, while they have brief exposure to investment practices, they lack the required deep Fixed Income or Capital Markets domain expertise and specific SQL Server/Oracle experience.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) across various paradigms and languages.
Strong background in CI/CD pipelines, DevOps infrastructure, and test-driven development.
Some exposure to the financial and investment sector through their role at RIDE Capital.
concerns: Lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ development experience, with only ~6 months of professional C/C++ listed.
No experience with the required Windows platform development, strongly favoring Linux, Web, and Node.js environments.
Missing required domain expertise in Capital Markets, Fixed Income, or Investment Banking.
